Ather Energy shares skyrocket 19% after EV maker swings to Rs 1.26 crore profit in Q2
items.summary: Ather Energy shares surged nearly 19% after the electric two-wheeler maker reported a net profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27, reversing a loss of Rs 154 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 62.8% year-on-year to Rs 1,464 crore, while the company also approved Rs 122 crore in capacity expansion.
